name: globe-geometry-build
description: Offline build pipeline: precomputes the 3D polygon geometry for every country (so the browser never has to triangulate 241 countries live), and bundles a patched local copy of three-globe that consumes the precomputed data. Not part of the Maven/Spring build — run manually with `npm install && npm run build` whenever countries-50m.json or the three-globe version changes.
